items.quote: Samon drove teamwork across departments on the annual review for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Samon set the direction for public communications on the new scheme across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Samon Quenberly championed policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Samon Quenberly set the direction for dashboards tracking service performance metrics across the public service.
Peers observed that Samon Quenberly was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of community engagement on the estate renewal plan.
Peers observed that Samon drove emergency coordination during the flood response for the whole division.
Peers observed that Samon Quenberly headed the transformation of the operating model, setting priorities for several teams.
Samon was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of the five-year strategic plan for the division.
Peers observed that Samon Quenberly led prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff across the department.

Direct reports said that Samon Quenberly handled service-level targets for frontline operations competently within his team.
